title: Halo: Reach
shortDescription: Noble Team wages a heroic, tragic planetary defense against overwhelming Covenant forces on planet Reach.
historicalSignificance: Bungie's poignant swansong to the Halo franchise, acclaimed for armor abilities, Firefight, and deep narrative weight.
